study.question: Does subtracting the visible-user background content-feedback moment from the existing shrunk joint residual improve validation four-task macro AUC over g2-r0009-joint_count (0.8280611590008863), and does count-based interpolation retain utility after that subtraction at matched capacity and measured cost? Observed limitation: the incumbent exceeds the stronger frozen source g0-r0003-relation_content_counts (0.8275704845768582) by only 0.0004906744240280592. Its covariance addition gains just 0.000009162654039607254 over g2-r0009-product_count. Smoothing direct fractions in g2-r0010-direct_count lowers macro AUC to 0.8278290867910927, while raw_count reproduces the incumbent exactly. These observations motivate testing separation of relative from user-wide feedback evidence, not another change to the direct fraction channel.
study.hypothesis: The absolute joint residual mixes relation-specific content-feedback association with a user-wide feedback background that may duplicate raw fractions, counts and backbone action information. Replacing that moment with excess/deficient feedback relative to the same visible user history may provide a better inductive bias, while raw fractions retain absolute feedback evidence. For slot s and task t, let mu_s=E[Wx|s], f_st=E[y_t|s], b_t=E[y_t|visible history] and alpha_s=n_s/(n_s+4), or 1/2 in fixed arms. The current exact-arithmetic feature is M_st=alpha_s E[Wx*y_t|s]+(1-alpha_s)mu_s*b_t. The proposed C_st=M_st-mu_s*b_t=alpha_s E[Wx*(y_t-b_t)|s]. This is a representation replacement using existing information; b is self-inclusive, not a calibrated reliability estimate, causal counterfactual or independent prior. Benefit is unverified. Trajectory review: initial DIN is 0.8099233880793816. Relation/replica fusion in round6 stayed below entry (relation count 0.8271699021137386; replicas count 0.8244067431535793). Aligned early/late fusion in round7 also regressed (count arms 0.8255833650069534/0.8245006439840328). The later separate residual reached 0.8280519963468467; marginal/content replacements gave 0.8279303769936712/0.8276346488369751. Joint covariance changed little, and direct smoothing regressed for both count and fixed arms. These are successful executions of weak/negative hypotheses, not missing data or mechanism refutations. The incumbent improves all four task AUCs over entry by [0.0004825521972586788,0.0009278151356856279,0.00003418655834919182,0.0005181438048186271] and task Logloss by [-0.00012126055879302378,-0.00010193523893719733,-0.000050330641821604016,-0.000064009124454565]. Against g2-r0004-count_shrink it gains macro 0.0007806253373326966 but loses buy AUC 0.002363698188522889 and worsens buy Logloss 0.00025510885887188636; it is also costlier (409.73s/32,964,809 parameters versus 286.96s/32,288,965 parameters; model-batch p50 28.37ms versus 10.45ms). Those trade-offs remain material. Count versus fixed joint mixing gains 0.00017486574028535706 macro AUC but worsens macro Logloss by 0.000012084971979797743. All supplied efficacy comparisons remain single-seed observations.

study.proposed_difference: A 2x2 factorial: centering_mode=user/none crossed with rate_interpolation=count/fixed. user subtracts projected slot mean times the same visible-user task-feedback background in FP32 before casting the combined moment back to the projected dtype. none computes the identical offset but multiplies it by zero. Raw direct fractions and counts are unchanged in every arm. Standalone files have identical AST outside literal CONFIG; each takes only the authorized API inputs and returns four [B,1] probabilities. New helper reads only existing moments, masked projected means, intersected feedback masks and valid history. No new fields, parameters, training loss, host settings, filesystem/network operations or installation. No novelty or new information claim: centering is an elementary moment transform. Its utility and difference from the broader literature remain unverified beyond the sources inspected. Local verification: syntax compile and import/source checks passed for all modules. Constructor body excluding scalar mode checks and all unchanged forward/group/rate/covariance methods match archived raw_count AST. Extracted _center_moments passed 240 standard-library array-adapter cases (length0/1/4/17/100, empty/full/pre-padded/holey histories, random/all-zero/all-one feedback, count/fixed and centered/absolute modes), with scalar-oracle maximum error 2.498001805406602e-16 and exact absolute-mode identity. This checks helper algebra/broadcasting only; torch/numpy/jsonschema are unavailable. Before full training the host must check actual torch forward/backward and finite dense/sparse gradients under FP32/BF16, all four output shapes, masked-ID/task-mask invariance, target-action invariance, length0 and empty/singleton/full histories, zero residual for empty histories, shared initial parameters, and same-state absolute_count/absolute_fixed agreement with the frozen corresponding joint sources. Centered modes must agree with the scalar formula within precision-derived tolerance. Preserve and charge any gate failure; do not reinterpret it as counterevidence or launch an untracked retry.
predictions: Primary efficacy prediction: center_count exceeds absolute_count and the incumbent 0.8280611590008863 on full validation macro AUC at the fixed training seed and recipe; it must also exceed both source bests to support the task utility claim. New outcomes are unknown.

Factorial attribution: define Delta_count=AUC(center_count)-AUC(absolute_count), Delta_fixed=AUC(center_fixed)-AUC(absolute_fixed), and interaction=Delta_count-Delta_fixed before observing outcomes. Positive centering effects in both modes support the representation transform; positive count-minus-fixed within centered arms supports occupancy-dependent mixing there. If only one cell improves, interpret the interaction rather than merging separate main-effect claims.

Algebraic prediction: constant historical task feedback gives approximately zero centered content moment; a slot with rate below the user background can produce a signed deficit; empty slots stay zero. Raw feedback rates and counts remain numerically identical across matched arms.

Cost prediction: same registered parameter counts and initialization; only O(B*8*4*8) extra background-offset work and a small background reduction. Measure total/train/inference seconds, p50/p95 model-batch latency and peak GPU bytes for every arm. Same-shaped arithmetic is a cost control, not a measured equal-time frontier.

Use only existing predeclared host history slices empty,1-16,17-64,>64 as secondary diagnostics with task sample/positive/negative counts. Sparse counts (e.g.13 buy positives in empty histories) limit interpretation; no slice veto or threshold is used for selection. No new diagnostic interface or unavailable timestamps/frequencies are assumed.
falsifiers: If center_count fails to exceed the stronger source and incumbent, reject added utility for this implementation under this recipe; retain the incumbent. If centered arms both fail their absolute controls, the centering utility prediction is opposed, not the entire compatibility topic refuted.

A count benefit disappearing or reversing after centering opposes an additive interpretation of occupancy shrinkage plus centering. An isolated favorable cell does not establish independent mechanisms.

A changed parameter count, initialization drift, absolute-control mismatch or dependence on padded IDs/current action invalidates attribution until diagnosed; it is an implementation/integrity failure, not a successful or negative scientific result.

A gain disappearing under admissible paired-seed repetitions or explained by later amplitude/gradient controls limits the redundancy interpretation. One seed cannot establish significance or repeated support.

A material measured compute or memory increase without a corresponding quality-cost benefit opposes the efficiency prediction even if macro AUC improves. No undeclared task-specific veto: always report and explain buy/favorite or Logloss regressions.
alternative_explanations: One fixed training seed and one pass; no seed-independent confirmation or user-cluster uncertainty in the supplied receipts. Deterministic calibration reruns do not constitute independent repetitions.

Centering changes feature amplitudes, content gradients and available absolute content signal, so an improvement can reflect optimization/regularization rather than a uniquely identified redundancy mechanism.

The user background includes each local group and is not an independent prior. Encoded category/brand matches, overlapping feedback masks and auxiliary-label semantics are inherited benchmark assumptions.
FP32 accumulation with BF16 projected means/events only approximately obeys the exact-arithmetic moment identity. Host precision checks must quantify this.

Centering could erase useful absolute content intensity or rare-action evidence. Failed direct-rate smoothing already warns that raw evidence matters; direct fractions are deliberately preserved, without claiming that guarantees success.

Selection across many related trials can favor a chance small improvement. Archived raw_count and product_count deterministic reproductions are lineage/calibration checks, not independent mechanism or seed evidence.

The offline released feedback visibility may include immature delayed actions, and auxiliary shopping labels match user/category/brand within24h rather than advertisement-specific conversions. This experiment establishes only the inherited offline benchmark scope.
